# Out There Together

> Out There Together is a free app for LGBTQ+ people who cruise. Members find their sailing, see who else has shortlisted or booked it, and make plans together before they board.

Key facts:

- It is free for members and has no paid tiers.
- It is a social cruise-discovery app. It is not a travel agent, a booking platform or a dating app.
- Members add a sailing to their shortlist or mark it Booked, see who else is going, join the sailing chat and plan meetups and shore days together.
- It does not take bookings or payments. When a member is ready to book, it points them to the cruise line or an authorised agent. Some of those partners pay a referral fee, explained in the affiliate disclosure.
- Members can verify their identity. Each member chooses what others can see, and can report, block or mute anyone.
- The Android app is on Google Play in the UK, the US and Canada. The iPhone app is with Apple for review. The web version works anywhere.
- It is operated by Blockbeam Ltd, a company registered in the United Kingdom.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://outtheretogether.com/): what the app does, how it works and frequently asked questions
- [Cruise lines](https://outtheretogether.com/cruise-lines/): how many members have shortlisted or booked a sailing with each cruise line, refreshed daily. Totals only, never names. Each cruise line has its own page
- [Android app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blockbeam.outthere)
- [Web version](https://app.outtheretogether.com/sign-in)
